allocation_decision_set: no_learning baseline and all candidate arms

regression.definition: candidate task success rate minus no-learning task success rate is at most -0.20 across five matched runs
regression.family_summary: mean paired task-success change within each STATE-Bench task family
regression.multiplicity_policy: Task-level regression flags are a descriptive screen. No per-task hypothesis claim is made from five runs.

trace_interpretation: These are trace inconsistency and execution diagnostics. They are not, by themselves, evidence of reward hacking.
outcome_gate: all 50 held-out tasks are present in all five runs per arm
task, state, efficiency, token, and user-experience fields are scored
file identities and content hashes are recorded before aggregation
infrastructure-invalid and unscored records block release
